fromContent: A Vornic packet that passes through more relays is dropped more often.
toContent: A Vornic packet that passes through more relays takes longer to arrive.
subtype: TRAP — co-consequences of hop count (common cause), not one deriving from the other

fromContent: Korl programs are unusually easy to unit-test.
toContent: Korl programs are unusually easy to run in parallel across many cores.
subtype: TRAP — both are consequences of purity (common cause); neither is the other's premise

fromContent: Market prices in tithe-credits climb in the final days of each cycle.
toContent: Charitable donations of tithe-credits spike in the final days of each cycle.
subtype: TRAP — both driven by the decay rule (common cause: holders offloading), not one from the other

fromContent: Strong Castellan players almost always develop a second warden in the opening.
toContent: Strong Castellan players almost always seize control of the board's centre in the opening.
subtype: TRAP — both are correlates of skilled play (common cause), not a derivation between the two habits

fromContent: Busier Vornic relays report a higher average drift on the packets they handle.
toContent: Busier Vornic relays drop more packets per hour.
subtype: TRAP — both track traffic volume (common cause); higher average drift doesn't itself cause the drops

fromContent: Lumen trees give off a faint glow on cold nights.
toContent: Lumen trees shed flakes of outer bark on cold nights.
subtype: TRAP — both triggered by cold (common cause); the glow and the bark-shedding are independent responses

fromContent: Glimmer-moth sightings reach their yearly peak in late summer.
toContent: The night owls that hunt over the same meadows are also most active in late summer.
subtype: TRAP — both are seasonal (common cause); shared timing invites a false predator-prey derivation

fromContent: A Daftari vault with more documents has a larger .daftari/index.db file.
toContent: A Daftari vault with more documents takes longer to reindex.
subtype: TRAP — both scale with document count (common cause); reindex reads the markdown, not the db, so db size isn't the premise
